title: Peter Brown Paints a Street Scene
content: Urban plein-air painterPete "The Street" Brownshares his thoughts as he paints a London cityscape.(Link to YouTube)He talks about the difficulty of choosing a motif and his ideas about "mapping out" the shapes with a brush on a piece of toned MDF board or canvas.The video shows how he builds up the image with blocks of tone rather than with lines defining boundaries.MDF Board, (11 x 14 in,)
